flaws.description: Swapped all five ax.plot(...) calls to ax.scatter(...), removing the line-only keywords linewidth=2 and linestyle='solid' (incompatible with scatter) while keeping color= and label=, turning the radar chart's connecting lines into disconnected points.
Swapped the numeric value lists of Growth Potential and Customer Acquisition (keeping variable names, colors, labels and plot order unchanged), so each series now plots the other's data.
